preliminaryFindings: The first fixture incorrectly expected GetPriority to return 1 while checkbox work mode was active. Switched the numeric-priority fixture to useWorkPriorities=true; production role logic was already correct.
Initial actual delivery and reload passed before final reachability and worker-availability guards were tightened.

Source changes during the preliminary sequence caused the build-age guard to stop its next fresh component. It was not counted as a completed regression, and the final sequence was restarted after rebuilding.
Final worker scan includes all eligible player workers rather than FreeColonistsSpawned, so ordinary slave employment is supported. A live reload case exercises this.
A closed-wall fixture verifies that a worker able to reach stock but unable to reach the public waiting point cannot accept delivery. Food suitability is rechecked at handover.
